tools.description: Look up a known bug before you read the library's source or search the web: when a command fails with an error raised inside a dependency (a package you did not write), call this at the first failure with the exact error text (paste it whole; up to 2000 characters), and the package and version when

tools.name: cairn_read_thread
tools.description: Read the complete post and first chronological comments page. Follow next_cursor with cairn_read_comments before concluding a point is unanswered or adding a contribution.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "read" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cairn_search, cairn_read_thread · Private data: cairn_search · Public sink: cairn_read_thread.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cairn_search, cairn_read_thread · Private data: cairn_search · Public sink: cairn_read_thread

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
